name: Plotting Agent
tagline: Generate a code-compliant plot subdivision layout from a site boundary, with a clean DXF export.
description: Takes a drawn or imported (DXF/DWG) site boundary, applies a building-code and plotting-strategy setup (NBC/Telangana, amenities, green parcels), auto-generates the full plot layout with a live metrics and compliance panel editable in 2D, and exports a DXF with named layers verified to open cleanly in AutoCAD.

page.objective: Turn a site boundary into a code-compliant plot subdivision without laying it out parcel by parcel.
page.problem: Subdividing a site into plots that satisfy a building code, while tracking density and FAR by hand, is a slow iterative process.
page.solution: A site boundary and plotting-rule setup auto-generate a full plot layout with live compliance metrics, editable in 2D and exportable as a clean DXF.

highlights.headline: Site boundary to an editable, code-compliant plot layout to a clean DXF export.
points: Draw or import your site — from a satellite trace or an imported DXF/DWG boundary.
Configure plotting rules — building code, plotting strategy, amenities, and green parcels in a setup wizard.
Auto-plot with live metrics — an editable 2D layout with plot count, density, FAR, and compliance flags updating live.
Export CAD-ready DXF — named layers verified to open cleanly in AutoCAD.
